samples.question: A single blue winding line starts at an orange ring and ends at the far side of the drawing. Three coloured dots (red, green, magenta) rest on the blue line at different positions. Trace the blue line from the orange ring and order the three dots by how far along the line each sits. Which coloured dot is in the MIDDLE of that order (neither first nor last): red, green, or magenta? Answer red, green, or magenta.
